title: Data Annotation Engineer
html:
Here at Ailytics, we’re building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

As a Data Annotation Engineer, you’ll be supporting the development of our AI models through data collection, labelling, model testing, and more. This is a hands-on role at the heart of our video analytics work.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Collect data from new and existing deployments using video management software, ensuring its quality in terms of variety, lighting, and angles.
  • Label objects based on specific guidelines, and review labelled data to identify model deficiencies.
  • Upkeep guidelines and procedures for data collection and labelling.
  • Collect test videos from various deployments to evaluate model performance, and suggest areas of improvement for data collection and labelling.
  • On an ad-hoc basis, assist in the writing of scripts to improve processes and increase efficiency in manipulation of data.
  • Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on progress, priorities, and problems, and assist with external stakeholders on an ad-hoc basis, such as demos.

Our Ideal Requirements

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in data annotation, data operations, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in scripting (e.g. Python) to automate processes and manipulate data.
  • Experience with project management software (such as Jira, Confluence).
  • High attention to detail and strong time management, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with confidence in updating stakeholders and supporting client demos.
  • Willingness to travel to deployment sites for on-site data collection.
  • Prior experience with computer vision, video analytics, video management software, or IP camera technologies/platforms is a great plus.
  • A self-starter with a growth mindset and a sense of ownership over your work.

Why Work At Ailytics?

  • This is an opportunity to create lasting impact and explore the intersection of AI and safety.
  • We’re a start-up that’s still in its early stages. If you’re looking for an environment where you can really make an impact, this is it.
  • We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.
